disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a provision of the Construction Contractors chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a rule or order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a rule or order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with the terms of a settlement agreement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entered into a settlement agreement with another person under ORS 701.145 but failed to comply with the terms of the settlement agreement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Is an owner/officer of a business entity that had a license revoked or suspended or was subject to a civil or criminal penalty related to construction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a business entity or is the owner, director, officer or partner of a business entity or of a reorganized business entity...that was subject to a revocation or suspension of a license, or subject to a civil or criminal penalty

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitted an application that was incomplete in a material respect or included an incorrect or misleading statement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submitted an application to the board that, at the time the board issued or renewed the license or denied the application, was incomplete in any material respect or included a statement that was incorrect or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly assisted an unlicensed person to act in violation of the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly assisted an unlicensed person to act in violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly assisted a licensed contractor to perform work for which the contractor is not properly endorsed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly assisted a licensed contractor to perform work for which the contractor is not properly endorsed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money causing a lien to be filed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money to a person and the failure caused the person to file a lien on a structure under ORS 87.001 to 87.093.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly provided false information to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly provided false information to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Worked without a construction permit where a permit is required and the work resulted in a complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Worked without a construction permit where a permit is required and the work resulted in a complaint being filed with the board under ORS 701.139.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Worked together with another contractor on the same task in violation of the rules for exempt-class contractors
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Worked together with another contractor on the same task on the same job site, where one of the contractors was classed as exempt under ORS 701.035 (2)(b)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of specified crimes including murder, assault, kidnapping, rape, arson, robbery, theft, or extortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Was convicted, or an owner, director, officer or partner of the licensee or applicant was convicted, consistent with ORS 670.280, of one of the following crimes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Did not pay for labor or materials under a public improvement contract within 90 days after receiving payment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Did not pay another person for supplying labor or materials contracted for under a public improvement contract, plus the amount of interest due, within 90 days after receiving payment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeatedly reported bad faith or false complaints of nonpayment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeatedly reported bad faith or false complaints of nonpayment against contractors or subcontractors.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in dishonest or fraudulent conduct as a contractor injurious to public welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in conduct as a contractor that was dishonest or fraudulent and that the board finds injurious to the welfare of the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hired employees while licensed as exempt under the independent contractor classification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Hired employees while licensed as exempt under ORS 701.035.
